description:
Superlight frame at 695g, all-road integrated frame up to 34mm tire clearance front and 32mm rear

The RIRA Ultra is our flagship high-performance racing frameset—engineered for riders who demand uncompromising speed, precision, and race-day readiness. Built on our proven RIRA Geometry and fine-tuned for aerodynamics. Every surface, edge, and profile is designed to reduce drag and enhance eﬃciency across all terrains.

Weighing just 695 g (Size M ±3%), the Ultra is meticulously constructed from over 300 layers of high-grade Toray carbon, strategically laid into custom moulds for optimal strength-to-weight ratio. The result is a feather- light chassis that reacts instantly to every watt you put down, delivering blistering responsiveness on climbs, sprints, and technical descents alike.

From the first pedal stroke to the final sprint, the RIRA Ultra brings pro-level performance within reach. Its aggressive-yet-balanced geometry provides nimble handling through corners and confident stability at high speed. Every gram has been shaved without compromising stiﬀness or ride quality, ensuring it feels fast and composed under maximum load. Whether you're attacking the breakaway, chasing a personal best, or hunting podiums, the Ultra is your ultimate weapon.

Aesthetically, the Ultra’s silhouette is clean, sculpted, and undeniably fast—turning heads whether you're leading the pack or out on a solo mission. It’s designed to be as functional as it is beautiful. The EVO386 bottom bracket platform provides compatibility with a broad range of cranksets, and the 27.2 mm seatpost diameter allows riders to fine-tune fit and comfort—or go all-in on weight savings with the 219 g C2 TUMU Seatpost.

Built exclusively for electronic drivetrains, the RIRA Ultra includes both SRAM UDH and Shimano Direct-Mount hangers for seamless setup across groupsets. Tyre clearance of 32 mm at the rear and 34 mm at the front ensures confident handling on rougher roads, cobbles, or broken tarmac—giving you race-level performance in real-world conditions.

The RIRA Ultra isn’t just about being light. It’s about redefining what lightweight can do. Engineered to push boundaries and built to win, it’s the purest expression of speed we’ve ever created.

components.description: Electric Only; SHIMANO® Di2, SRAM® eTAP & Campagnolo® EPS compatible; Di2 SM-BTR-2 or BT-DN300 and EPS V3 Battery Compatible
Seatclamp 8-10Nm, Thru-Axle 3-4Nm, Rear Derailleur Hanger 3-4Nm, Water Bottle Cage Bolts 2-3Nm, Thru-Axle 10Nm, MANA 6Nm
